column2: [intro]
In my head, there’s so much nonsense,
Wacky ideas that bring me immense joy.
I invent games, and silly words,
To brighten up those dull, gray days.
I want to talk of trivial things,
Little joys that make life sing.
Let’s forget the worries and the fuss,
And dance away with joyful trust!
I’ve got a knack for making crowds laugh,
My humor spins like a grand carousel.
I juggle words and puns galore,
To help you forget the clouds and more.
Let me talk of trivial things,
Of love wrapped in surprise blings.
Smile, dance, and let worries fade,
In this light life, all’s fair game!
[ solo ]
I want to talk of trivial things,
Little joys that make life sing.
Let’s forget the worries and the fuss,
And dance away with joyful trust!
[outro]
